title: Congress Student Wing NSUI Protests Against Rising Air Pollution In Delhi

ai.summary: The National Students' Union of India staged a protest on Raisina Road demanding urgent action against Delhi's rising pollution, as air quality index levels stood at 330 (very poor) on Thursday.

facts.claim: The National Students' Union of India staged a protest on Raisina Road
facts.quote: - NSUI protested on Raisina Road, demanding urgent action against Delhi’s rising pollution.

facts.claim: The protest was led by its national president, Vinod Jakhar
facts.quote: The protest was held at the NSUI headquarters on Raisina Road and was led by its national president, Vinod Jakhar.

facts.claim: Delhi’s AQI stood at 330 (very poor) on Thursday
facts.quote: Delhi’s AQI stood at 330 (very poor) on Thursday, with further deterioration forecast.

ai.background_note: The protest occurred amid Delhi's deteriorating air quality, with pollution levels remaining a major concern as the winter season sets in.
